findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe YAML deserialization in awscli
 * @description Detects use of yaml.load or other unsafe YAML loaders that may lead to code execution when parsing untrusted input.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/awscli-unsafe-yaml-load
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load", "FullLoader"]).getACall()
select call, "Potential unsafe YAML deserialization using 'yaml.load' or an unsafe loader. Prefer 'safe_load' with trusted input only."
findings.hypothesis: Package may use yaml.load or unsafe loaders on untrusted data

message.text: Potential unsafe YAML deserialization using 'yaml.load' or an unsafe loader. Prefer 'safe_load' with trusted input only.
